propositions: Tickets-store git repository has ~1 GiB of spent/unreachable history that must be reclaimed via length-aware history strip and repack to bring filtered pack size under 131072 KiB CI gate limit.

History rewrite must preserve exact tree, commit count, merge-commit count, and normalized event identity multisets (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) while removing .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ residual history.

Off-repo backup bundles must be created before and after coordinated repair of ticket 30d3, verified independently, and retained as rollback artifacts before any history rewrite or force-with-lease publication.

Deterministic first post-rewrite writer vote must be the sole commit in measurement interval with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN disabled, leaving old-tip ancestry false and post-rewrite size-pack growth below 1 MB.

All writer pauses (workflows, AWS timer, LaunchAgents), ref pins, and epoch barriers must be explicitly validated before convergence and restored after publication, with final reconciler pass and fsck confirming zero repairable diagnostics and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records.

Exact force-with-lease publication and default-clone verification must prove old tip is not an ancestor and identity-report multisets match byte-for-byte between pre-publication and post-publication epochs.
